hOptionalUITextStyleFields.szPreviewText: Acquire both Free and Premium Reliquaries packed with rewards. To unlock rewards in a Premium Reliquary, you must purchase Premium Access for it using Platinum.

Le passe de combat est constitué d’un reliquaire standard et de 3 reliquaires premium. Les reliquaires premium peuvent être achetés avec des {c_highlight}pièces de platine{/c} {icon:CurrencyIcon, 2.0} individuellement ou dans des packs proposant des récompenses supplémentaires ou des prix plus avantageux.

Introducing Reliquaries, a new reward delivery system like the Battle Pass that consists of collections of items including Armor Sets, Mounts, and more that you can choose to progress towards and claim.
Acquire both Free and Premium Reliquaries packed with rewards. To unlock rewards in a Premium Reliquary, you must purchase Premium Access for it using Platinum.

Introducing Reliquaries, a new reward delivery system like the Battle Pass that consists of collections of items including Armor Sets, Mounts, and more that you can choose to progress towards and claim.
Acquire both Free and Premium Reliquaries packed with rewards. To unlock rewards in a Premium Reliquary, you must purchase Premium Access for it using Platinum.

Introducing Reliquaries, a new reward delivery system like the Battle Pass that consists of collections of items including Armor Sets, Mounts, and more that you can choose to progress towards and claim.
Rewards can either be earned or bought with        Platinum. Claim all of the items in a Reliquary to earn a free and special bonus Completion Reward.
Earn Favor by killing monsters and completing quests. You may collect and save what you earn to claim rewards of your choice.

Maximize your earnings by keeping track of the cap at 99        Favor. To earn additional tokens, your collection must be under this limit. Note that Favor may also be carried from season to season to use for other rewards.
Rewards may have the option to be claimed with Favor. For Premium Reliquaries, Premium Access must be purchased first before you can claim those rewards.
